## Fixes after delivery

Record a problem found after a slice is `done` as a known issue in Beads when the repository has `.beads/`; otherwise record it in the roadmap's [Known issues (source: guides/product-documentation-process.md#roadmap)] section. It does not interrupt current work unless the developer says so. The main session offers the developer a choice between a standalone fix and a new slice.

A standalone fix restores behavior the documents already specify and adds a regression test that would have caught the problem, written by a different worker from the fix. It goes through the same [code review cycle](skill://orchestrate-factory/references/code-review--review-cycle.md) and [developer validation](skill://orchestrate-factory/references/product-documentation-process--11-validate-and-close-the-milestone.md) as a slice. Do not revise frozen documents or create a PRD, system design, TDD, or plan merely to satisfy this path.

When the documented behavior itself is wrong, use a new slice. A fix-only slice adds its own TDD and implementation plan; it does not by itself require a system design. For an existing multi-slice feature, update or reopen its system design under [document state and revision](skill://orchestrate-factory/references/product-documentation-process--document-state-and-revision.md), preserving delivered-slice sections. Take changed documents through their review loops and [gates](skill://orchestrate-factory/references/product-documentation-process--approvals.md).
